faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild engines for all Discovery Sport models?
faqLeft.a: Yes — we rebuild and replace engines across the full L550 range, from launch in 2014 to the current model.

faqLeft.q: Do I keep my original engine, or do you send me a different one?
faqLeft.a: We rebuild the engine your Discovery Sport already has wherever possible, avoiding the compatibility risks that come with fitting a used engine of unknown history.
Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqLeft.q: What warranty comes with a rebuild?
faqLeft.a: Every rebuild comes with a 12 month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqRight.a: We collect your car nationwide from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: How much does a Discovery Sport engine rebuild cost?
faqRight.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000 across the range, whether Ingenium diesel, Ingenium petrol, or the earlier Ford Duratorq diesel. Exact price depends on engine code and condition — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqRight.q: My Discovery Sport is a pre-2016 model — does that change anything?
faqRight.a: It might. Pre-2016 Discovery Sports were fitted with the Ford Duratorq diesel rather than Land Rover's own Ingenium engine, and that unit has its own known pattern of injector seal leaks and EGR clogging. Submit your reg and we'll confirm exactly which engine your car has before quoting.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
